gloss: Moab, the people descended from Lot
summary: Genesis traces the Moabites to Lot’s son Moab. The same name designates their territory and kingdom east of the Dead Sea.

senses.definition: Ruth moves from the country of Moab to Bethlehem. The psalm depicts Moab as a washbasin, placing it in a servant’s position.
Ruth, the Moabite woman who comes back with Naomi, carries the name of her people after she leaves their land.

note: Genesis 19:37 relates the name to the birth narrative without explicitly defining its parts. Moab’s personal entry records the ancestor.
